import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, A):
        A = np.asarray(A, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = A.shape[0]
        assert A.shape == (dim_0, 2, 2)
        # B_i = A_i
        self.B = np.zeros((dim_0, 2, 2))
        for i in range(1, dim_0+1):
            self.B[i-1] = A[i-1]
